name: method-ab-experiment
title_zh: 锁死唯一自变量，A/B 实验才不算白跑
tagline_zh: 跑模型对比总被缓存、session 或工具状态悄悄污染？这套 Skill 帮你隔离跨 run 脏状态。
tagline_en: Tired of A/B runs polluted by cache, session, or tool state? This skill isolates cross-run dirt, verifies.
desc_en: 设计或审查模型、Agent、缓存、上下文、工具策略、runtime 优化的 A/B/qualification 实验时使用。用于锁唯一自变量、隔离 cache/session/evidence/model residency 等跨 run 状态、确认机制真正触发，并把“机制生效”“任务收益”“可推广/可发布”分层裁决；特别适合本地模型和长 Agent benchmark。简单确定性单测不需要加载。
why_zh: 它把实验设计变成一道门禁：先锁自变量，再查隔离，最后才判收益。机制没触发就喊停，省得你拿噪声当结论。
why_en: It turns experiment design into a gate: lock the variable, verify isolation, then judge. If the mechanism never fires, it stops.
limit_zh: 只服务 A/B 和 qualification 实验设计或审查；简单确定性单测请绕道。不跑实验本身，也不分析数据。
limit_en: Only for A/B or qualification experiment design/review; skip for simple deterministic tests. It doesn't run experiments or analyze data. Requires a.
title_en: A/B experiments that isolate the one variable that matters
